name: pk
description: Starter pack for scam patterns commonly reported in Pakistan (community contributions welcome).

rules.title: Unofficial 'relief payment' or income-support claim
rules.explanation: Scammers send texts claiming you are eligible for a government payment and ask you to click a link, send an ID number or pay a fee. Check eligibility only through the official channels you already know.

rules.title: Says your SIM or number will be blocked
rules.explanation: Messages saying your SIM will be blocked unless you act now are a common social-engineering hook. Contact your network using a number you already trust.

rules.title: Prize-bond, 'inam' or lucky-draw claim
rules.explanation: Surprise prize, 'inam' or lucky-draw messages that ask for a fee or personal details are almost always scams.

rules.title: Mobile wallet or account 'limited/blocked' warning
rules.explanation: Fake alerts say your mobile wallet is limited or blocked and ask for a PIN, CNIC or OTP. Wallet providers never ask for your PIN or OTP by message or call.
